product_summary: Trivikram Flowtech (brand 'TFT Pumps'), Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu — ISO 9001:2015 pump manufacturer. Real catalogue per own site tftpumps.com and IndiaMART profile: centrifugal pumps (water pumps, chemical process pumps, slurry pumps incl. submersible slurry, paper & pulp stock pumps, auto-priming dewatering pumps, 'Flood Fighter', vertical axial flow / inclined axial flow propeller pumps, horizontal split case pumps, multistage pumps, submersible water pumps, dredging pumps); positive displacement pumps (AODD/diaphragm, gear pumps, single screw pumps, shuttle block pumps); vacuum pumps; accessories (mechanical seals, couplings, Miller couplings, strainers/Y-fittings, hoses); plus non-pump lines — hydrocyclone filters, PU mesh screens, blow bars for HSI crushers. Declared industries: paper & pulp, chemical & processing, mining, dewatering, agriculture, energy/oil & gas.
role_hint: manufacturer (own site and IndiaMART both state 'Nature of Business: Manufacturer', ISO 9001:2015 certified plant, 101-500 employees). No trader signs found in the product presentation; accessories (seals, couplings, hoses, PU mesh) may be traded/outsourced but this is not stated publicly.
comment: HS 841370 is CORRECT and is the core code — centrifugal pumps dominate the catalogue (water, chemical process, slurry, paper stock, dewatering, multistage, split case, axial flow). Match = partial, not exact, because the declaration omits the whole positive-displacement and vacuum segment: 841360 (gear, single screw, shuttle block), 841350 (AODD), 841410 (vacuum pumps), and 841391 for pump parts/seals/couplings. HS 847420 (crushing/grinding machinery) is only marginally supported: the site lists 'Blow Bars' for horizontal shaft impactors — that is a crusher wear part, not a machine, and would more properly sit under 8474.90 (parts) rather than 847420 (machines). So 847420 is a weak/over-broad line: the company does not appear to manufacture crushing or grinding machines themselves. Additional lines missing from the declaration: hydrocyclone filters and strainers (8421), PU mesh screens (3926/7314). Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is only partly right — chemical processing is a genuine served industry, oil & gas is listed as an industry page but the product range is generic industrial pumps; the company's real weight is paper & pulp, mining/dewatering and M-sand, so the industry label is narrower than reality. Per project rule 3, the HS discrepancy is NOT a rejection ground: company is kept, codes corrected to 841370 + 841360 + 841350 + 841410 + 841391, with 847420 downgraded to a parts-only line. All product claims above are from the company's own website (tftpumps.com) and its IndiaMART profile — no customs line was available in this task, so the export/import product mix is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note: IndiaMART profile shows GST 33AADFT0735A1ZV and IEC 3216905217 as published by the platform; these are quoted as displayed, not verified here.
